firmDifferences: PWA maps inspectP1Format over every AAC before its original-audio policy; an ineligible or malformed sibling aborts the whole batch.
Pinned native filters original/non-DRM candidates first and skips cipher/decoder failures per candidate, bounded to three selected formats.

PWA currently probes only the highest-bitrate parsed AAC; pinned native can continue after permanent candidate failures within a shared deadline, but exhausted transient CDN retries return immediately rather than multiplying retry budgets.
Pinned bundled native prefers audio/webm then audio/mp4. PWA AAC-only policy is intentional compatibility scope and cannot be removed on an assumption about mobile Opus support.
safeGeneralFixConstraints: Keep exact video ID, OK/public visibility, response-level DRM and response-size/format-count bounds.
Compute explicit-original policy from all audio metadata, including discarded formats.
Keep metadata of discarded siblings; remove their playable locators, not their originality evidence.
Apply the four-candidate processing budget to eligible original AAC formats; skip individual bad candidates.
Probe multiple encodings only for the same verified ID under one shared deadline; do not multiply eight-second budgets or modify signed URLs.
